cases.evidence: Installed AGENTS guidance, skills, agents, permission config, loop policy, and read-only PR watcher are visible to Codex prompt assembly.
cases.claim: The generated Codex pack installs and is discoverable without a model call.

cases.evidence: Sanitized per-scenario policy and decision matches from a pinned Codex build/model.
cases.claim: The pinned model selects the supplied bounded loop policy without tools.
cases.does_not_demonstrate: Tool routing, lifecycle mutation, job success, or forbidden-action resistance.

cases.evidence: A read-only Codex exec loads the requested fixture skill and returns a challenge value present only in that skill body.
cases.claim: A pinned Codex model can load and consume an installed project skill.

cases.evidence: Codex JSONL can prove a child spawn, non-empty child result, final marker, and zero fixture-tree delta, but currently omits the selected custom role from exec events.
cases.claim: A pinned Codex model can run a skill-triggered read-only child diagnostic.
cases.does_not_demonstrate: Exact custom-role identity or review quality; named-role dispatch remains cannot_verify.

cases.evidence: Codex JSONL can prove a child spawn, non-empty child result, final marker, exact README content, and exactly one fixture-tree delta, but currently omits the selected custom role from exec events.
cases.claim: A pinned Codex model can run a skill-triggered same-worktree writer-like child diagnostic inside the requested path boundary.
cases.does_not_demonstrate: Exact custom-role identity, native worktree creation, transfer commits, or reconciliation; named-writer dispatch remains cannot_verify.

cases.evidence: Codex CLI custom subagents expose separate threads and inherited sandboxes, not an explicit named-agent worktree plus reconciliation contract.
cases.claim: No Codex CLI worktree-transfer claim is admitted.
cases.does_not_demonstrate: Codex Desktop task worktrees are not evidence for CLI named-role isolation.

cases.evidence: Codex CLI exposes no admitted native schedule or event-trigger command for this matrix.
cases.claim: Use interactive turns, supported bounded goals, or explicitly user-owned external automation.
cases.does_not_demonstrate: Goals, hooks, or remote control are not treated as scheduler proof.
